text:
Maya Patel: Kicking off a short probe pilot with NovaEdge to validate perf/W improvements from kernel tuning + power profile adjustments. Goal: quantify throughput/W delta on our standard Llama-compat workload and hand off tuned kernel bits to partner. Need quick owners and measurement plan.

Jon Reyes: I can own kernel side. plan to iterate on CPU freq governor, scheduler tweaks, and PMU counters. starting with a single-node smoke run.

Li Wei: I'll set up the telemetry and power baseline. want both wall-power (PDU) and onboard sensors (ipmi) + perf counters.

Rachel Kim: I'll coordinate infra and partner access — NovaEdge will ship 3 units to our lab on Mon. I have the SLA for data sharing.

Jon Reyes: Proposed minimal test steps:
1) baseline run (stock kernel) x5
2) apply governor + sched patch A, run x5
3) apply pmu/irq balancing patch B, run x5
4) combine patches, run x10
We record tokens/sec, p95 latency, and total Wh for each run.

Li Wei: Measurement commands I'm going to use:
```
# perf counters for throughput/latency
sudo perf stat -e instructions,cycles,cache-misses -a sleep 60
# power via ipmi (onboard)
ipmitool sdr elist | grep -i power
# wall power via PDU (CSV export)
```
Please ensure timestamps sync (ntp) across nodes.

Maya Patel: Good. We also need to capture model-level variability (seed/dataset) — use the standard eval set: 'redwood-probe-1k'.

Jon Reyes: For kernel patches I'll create a small PR with diff and a compile artifact. Naming: `rbw-kernel-tune/novaedge-<patch>`

Rachel Kim: NovaEdge asked about a non-disclosure template for telemetry. I sent them the draft earlier today; awaiting signature.

bench-bot: Scheduled run created: run-1812345679-01 (baseline) -> ETA 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. Logs will stream to: https://bench.redwood/internal/runs/1812345679-01

Li Wei: One more ask — can we capture thermal throttling counters and GPU freq logs? add `sensors` and `dmesg` snapshot pre/post.

Jon Reyes: Yep adding `dmesg -T > dmesg.pre` and `dmesg -T > dmesg.post` to harness, and `watch -n1 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw,clocks.current --format=csv` for GPU devices.

Maya Patel: Owners and deadlines:
- Jon Reyes: kernel patches and smoke runs (ETA first patch by Fri COB)
- Li Wei: telemetry spec + run dashboards (ETA Wed EOD)
- Rachel Kim: partner intake + NDA sign (ETA Mon)
- Maya Patel: overall coordination and exec summary (ETA next Tue)

Rachel Kim: Acked. I'll upload contact + shipping details in the partnership sheet. @NovaEdge please ping here when units are in transit.

NovaEdge (external): thanks! shipping label shared — ETA Mon night. looking forward to results. :rocket:

Maya Patel: Great. We'll treat this as a short scoped collaboration: 2-week probe. We'll surface topline perf/W and 3 recommended kernel knobs if positive. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
